Company Information

 

 

Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co.,Ltd 

       Dongguan AOSI Electronics Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of terminals and connectors integrating R&D, production, and sales, with a high-quality management team and technical elites. After nearly 10 years of careful operation, our products have passed certifications such as UL, VDE, CB, CQC, and ROHS, and the factory has obtained ISO9001:2008 quality management system certification.
      AOSI covers an area of 15,000 square meters with a building area of 10,000 square meters, employing more than 200 people, including 30 R&D personnel. The company has established a series of core departments, such as R&D center, mold workshop, automatic tapping, and automatic assembly workshop. The R&D center is equipped with advanced CIMS systems, and the mold workshop is equipped with hundreds of high-precision devices to maintain and enhance the craftsmanship of precision injection molding, stamping, die casting, and cutting.

FAQ

 

 

Q1. Can I have a sample order for Terminal blocks?
A: Yes, we welcome sample order to test and check quality. Mixed samples are acceptable.

 

Q2. What about the lead time?
A:Sample needs 1-2 days, mass production time needs 1-2 weeks for order quantity more than 100K pieces

 

Q3.About the payment?
A: The payment terms can be flexiable depend on the quantity and products. We firstly prefer Trade Assurance on alibaba,Another, new customer we prefer the 100% T/T before shipping or 30%T/T advance before

producing large quantity.

 

Q4. How do you ship the goods and how long does it take to arrive?

A: We usually ship by DHL, UPS, FedEx or TNT. It usually takes 3-5 days to arrive. Airline and sea shipping also optional.


Q5.About the delivery time:
A:For regular products, we keep them in stock. We can meet the quickest shipment according to customers’ requirement.

 

Q6.Q7: Do you offer guarantee for the products?
A: Yes.
